title: Deed in Lieu and Relocation Incentive Terms of the Payoff and Loan Satisfaction Product
content:
## Deed in lieu conditions and relocation incentive — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

Under the Payoff and Loan Satisfaction product only the Deed in Lieu of Foreclosure plan takes a deed instead of funds, and only it offers a cash-for-keys relocation incentive to occupants who vacate.

| Setting | Borrower Voluntary Payoff | HECM-to-HECM Refinance Payoff | Heir Retention Payoff | Estate Market Sale Payoff | Approved Short Sale Payoff | Deed in Lieu of Foreclosure |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| The property must be vacant and broom-clean before the deed in lieu is accepted | no | no | no | no | no | yes |
| Title must be free of other liens before the deed in lieu is accepted | no | no | no | no | no | yes |
| Largest relocation incentive paid to occupants who vacate under a deed in lieu | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 | USD 3000.00 |
| Calendar days after the agreement is signed within which the property must be vacated to earn the incentive | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 60 |
| A vacancy inspection must confirm the property is vacant before the incentive is paid | no | no | no | no | no | yes |
| How the relocation incentive is paid | by check | by check | by check | by check | by check | by check |

An incentive of USD 0.00 and a vacating period of 0 days mean the plan offers no incentive.

### Condition and result

| Condition on a Deed in Lieu of Foreclosure | Result |
|---|---|
| Property vacant and broom-clean, title free of other liens | the deed in lieu can be accepted |
| Property not vacant, or title carrying another lien | the deed in lieu is not accepted |
| Occupants vacate within 60 calendar days after signing and a vacancy inspection confirms it | the incentive of up to USD 3000.00 is paid by check |
